title: ph connect config dual-writes a connect.* change into both the source config and the served dist config
content:
## Six modes, one per invocation

`ph connect config` reads and writes every `connect.*` field:

```bash
ph connect config                                   # list the effective merged block
ph connect config connect.renown.url                # get (positional)
ph connect config --get connect.renown.url          # get (flag form, equivalent)
ph connect config connect.renown.chainId 137        # set (positional)
ph connect config --renown-chain-id 137             # set (per-field flag)
ph connect config --json '{"drives":{"allowAddDrive":false}}'   # bulk set
```

Positional `<key>/<value>`, `--get`, `--json`, and the field flags are **mutually exclusive** — combining them errors out. A positional `<value>` is JSON-parsed first (`137` → number, `false` → boolean) then Ajv-validated against the runtime schema at that path; bad types fail loudly *before* any write. Arrays and objects must go through `--json`.

## The dual write

A set or bulk-set patches two files:

1. The **source** `powerhouse.config.json` at the project root, deep-merged into `connect.*` — so the next `ph connect build` inherits it.
2. The **dist** `powerhouse.config.json` (default `.ph/connect-build/dist/`, overridable with `--dist-dir` or `PH_CONNECT_OUTDIR`), deep-merged the same way — so the currently-served SPA picks it up on its next refresh, no rebuild needed.

If the dist file does not exist the second write is skipped **silently** — that is the intended "configure before the first build" workflow, not an error.

Two gotchas. `--packages-registry` does not land under `connect.*`: it writes the top-level `packageRegistryUrl`, a project-wide field also read by `ph install`, `ph publish` and Switchboard. And `connect.pwa` is build-time only — `ph connect config` will happily write it but cannot rebuild the service worker, so PWA changes need `ph connect build`.

`ph connect build` exposes the identical flag surface but has no read mode; passing `<key>` without `<value>` there errors out. Note a doc lag: the academy closes every config recipe with `ph service restart`, yet `service` is absent from the CLI's dispatch table (`phCliCommandNames`).

_Source: `clis/ph-cli/src/services/connect-config.ts` and `apps/academy/docs/academy/03-Build/05-Launch/04-ConfigureEnvironment.md`, Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
description: One invocation patches powerhouse.config.json and the built dist copy, so the running SPA picks the change up on refresh without a rebuild.
